verdict.rationale: Rippling's own marketing says AI can build reports and dashboards from workforce data, such as labor cost trends and overtime by location. It also shows a natural-language prompt ("Show me headcount vs plan.") producing a headcount dashboard. Employees can also get AI answers about benefits. This covers AI-generated insights from in-product data, but proactive AI suggestions are not evidenced and the claims are marketing-level only. Missing for 10: proactive AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, in-depth documentation of how the AI analytics work, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Use AI to build reports and dashboards on labor cost trends, overtime by location, and more.
A tablet displaying an Annual Headcount Plan dashboard with purple line charts and a prompt reading "Show me headcount vs plan."
Employees can get instant answers to questions, compare plans, and submit qualifying life events with AI, on desktop and mobile.
